notes.title: Side42 Demo – Major Update!
notes.content:
– Added a [b]Steam achievemen[/b]t for launching the demo.
– Now featuring full credits – everyone gets the spotlight!
– Dynamic camera transitions bring scenes to life like never before.
– New orthographic camera mode for smoother gameplay – switch with a single button!
– Controls have been fine-tuned for a better feel and responsiveness.
– Full save system implemented – your progress is now fully protected.
– Language selection is now available, with your choice saved automatically.
– Clean interface: the language menu disappears once your selection is made.
– Various minor bugs squashed for a smoother experience.
– Fresh new tracks added to levels 1A and 1B – enjoy the vibe!
– Language settings now accessible directly from the main menu.
– Visual polish: several in-game elements have been enhanced.
– French menu issue fixed – no more forced English redirects!
– Expanded tutorial with more helpful information for new players.
– Fixed a crash caused by deleting an empty save file.
– Revamped designs for certain enemies and info elements – sharper than ever.
– Overall game optimization for better performance across the board.

notes.title: 🎮 Announcement of the Release of the Demo for "Side42: The Tavern of Infinity"
notes.content:
[b]Hello to all video game enthusiasts ![/b]

We are thrilled to announce the release of the demo for our brand new game, Side42: The Tavern of Infinity.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45064238/287efc63c1df3622c8dee8178b8c69758be98541.jpg[/img]

After months of hard work and sleepless nights, our team is finally ready to offer you a glimpse of what awaits you in the incredible (or nightmarish) world of Side42: The Tavern of Infinity.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45064238/a09799346af62bf2a7a7562c05749ddf5672123c.png[/img]

                                               🌟 About the Game : Side42 🌟

                             You are a [b]hero[/b]. You saved the universe. Yay, congrats.

              Now you've got to go all the way back to your favourite tavern to brag about your exploits. 

[olist]
[*] -An odd journey awaits you, challenging your reflexes like never before. 
[*] -Inspired by platformers from the 90s, navigate through unique levels, blending hand drawn and 3D graphics. 
[*] -This is speedrunner's heaven (or hell, who knows?). Have you got what it takes to set the best time ever?
[/olist]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45064238/4575ceb6b170bd9ec9b374084749e4a2bfe5368d.jpg[/img]

🚀 What to Expect from the Demo :

[list]
[*] [b]First levels[/b] : Dive into the first three levels of the game and a bonus level designed especially for your suffering pleasure.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45064238/1205437d385bfe709855ef856bce789dda4007b1.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45064238/4478b0a5029de9c5626c8b9243bcec4b1e3ec083.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45064238/3374a839594994874d71f1ad4e11d509ebcd8708.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*] [b]Game mechanics[/b] : Discover the main game mechanics and try to master your skills with a tutorial that won't go easy on you.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45064238/38bb9d5ef4c5f2076fb5bd46c505ddc40a0b9e08.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45064238/4d7c5056052b514c668542e6841c418c44ec61bd.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*] [b]Graphics and ambiance[/b] : Enjoy (or endure) the unique visual and sound universe we have created, a strange blend of old and next-gen 2D/3D.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45064238/1d172404a47e659ebaabd359e85f84779bb4992c.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45064238/6706d006312b53d78ebdd4f8087fd8a5656cc882.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*] [b]Feedback[/b] : We eagerly await your suggestions to make the game even more unforgiving
[/list]

💬 [b]Join the Community[/b] : 

We invite you to join our community on [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/Side42/]Reddit[/url], where you can stay up to date, share your opinions, and keep informed about the latest upcoming news.

https://www.reddit.com/r/Side42/

🙏 [b] Thank you [/b]to each of you for your continuous support. It is thanks to your passion and enthusiasm that we are [b]motivated[/b] to create unforgettable (and slightly sadistic) gaming experiences.
 We hope you enjoy this first dive into the hell of Side42: The Tavern of Infinity, and we look forward to hearing about your exploits with great anticipation.

Download the demo now and prepare for an infernal experience!

[b]Thank you and good luck[/b]!

Team GDK/V3ry
